items.title: Religious facility revenue bonds at 1780 Orchard Heights Avenue
items.summary: Consider approval of tax-exempt religious facility revenue bonds for the borrower. The agenda states that the City would have no responsibility or liability for the bonds.

items.title: Continued hearing on short-term rentals and fees
items.summary: Hold the continued public hearing and consider a short-term rental ordinance and a resolution establishing program fees.

items.title: Municipal Code provisions for City committees
items.summary: Introduce ordinances for Parks and Recreation, Economic Development, and Public Works Advisory committees, and amend the Financial and Audit Committee chapter.

items.title: Tilden-Coil services for the new police station
items.summary: Consider a professional services agreement with Tilden-Coil Constructors for project program management and owner’s representative services for CIP PS-07, the new police station.

items.title: $80,000 sponsorship request for the 2027 IOA Championship
items.summary: Consider FGTA, Inc. / Epson Tour’s request for an $80,000 City sponsorship of the IOA Championship, April 19–25, 2027, at Morongo Golf Club at Tukwet Canyon.

items.title: Downtown Revitalization Phase I
items.summary: Discuss implementation of Phase I of the City’s Downtown Revitalization Plan.

items.title: Banning agreement for Highland Springs Avenue improvements
items.summary: Consider a cooperative agreement establishing Beaumont’s and Banning’s roles and responsibilities for Highland Springs Avenue street improvements.

items.title: Tyler Technologies three-year enterprise renewal
items.summary: Consider a three-year amendment for FY2026–27 through FY2028–29: $631,892.93 in contract services plus $346,144.50 in estimated wastewater billing usage, totaling $978,037.43.
